title: All Of Create
description: All of CREATE mods in one place!
body:
![All Of Create Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/94ed3869122b4d2d2c48fba61cd373e019e738a6_0.webp) # ⚙️ Welcome to All Of Create **All Of Create** transforms Minecraft into the ultimate engineer's sandbox. If you love the mechanical marvels of the **Create** mod, this pack takes it to the next level by bringing together a massive collection of the best Create addons available! ### 🏭 Endless Possibilities Step into a world where your imagination is the only bottleneck. With our carefully curated selection of mechanics and expansions, you can: * Construct sprawling, fully automated **Factories**. * Design and manage complex **Train Stations** with intricate railway networks. * Push technology to its absolute limits... even engineering your own **nuclear warheads**. Perfect for a long-term survival world, **All Of Create** is designed to grow with you. Automate everything, build massive contraptions, and expand your technological empire for as long as you have ideas! --- > **⚠️ IMPORTANT DOWNLOAD NOTICE** > We now offer separate **Server** and **Client** versions of the modpack. Please double-check your selection before downloading to ensure a smooth installation! --- ### 📦 What's Inside? This pack contains dozens of expansions for Create, alongside essential performance boosters and quality-of-life mods to keep your massive factories running smoothly.
Click to expand the featured mod list: **Create & Addons:** * [Create [FABRIC]](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-fabric) * Create: Big Cannons * Create: Steam 'n' Rails * Create: Nuke * Create: Ultimate Factory * Create: Dreams & Desires * Create: Diesel Generators [Fabric] * Create: Crafts & Additions * Create: Interactive * *...and over 25+ more Create addons including Deco, Jetpack, Ore Excavation, Estrogen, Bells & Whistles, and Utilities!* **Performance, QoL & Visuals:** * Valkyrien Skies * Farmer's Delight [Fabric] * Xaero's World Map * Just Enough Items [JEI] * Sodium, Sodium Extra, Indium & Iris (High FPS & Shaders support) * Zoomify * Entity Model Features [EMF] & Entity Texture Features [ETF] * Trinkets * *...plus many more essential libraries, optimization mods, and tweaks!*
